privacyPolicy.introduction: Confess is designed from the ground up to protect your identity and your words. We believe that true anonymity enables honest expression. This Privacy Policy explains in full detail what we collect, why we collect it, how it is protected, and what rights you hold over your information. By using Confess, you agree to the practices described here.
infoWeCollect: Google Sign-In: We collect your email address and Firebase UID solely for account identification. We do not store your Google password or any other Google account data.

Alias & Password: You choose a nickname (alias) displayed in the app. Any optional alias password you set is hashed using bcrypt and stored only on your local device — never transmitted to our servers.

Posts & Stories: All text content you create is encrypted end-to-end (E2EE) on your device using AES-256 before being uploaded. We store only the encrypted ciphertext. We cannot read, access, or moderate your content.
Reactions: We record which user UID reacted to which post (as an encrypted reference) and the reaction type (👍 Like, 🤝 Support, 🫂 Us by Us). Only one reaction per user per post is permitted.
Analytics: We collect anonymized crash reports and aggregate usage statistics (e.g., number of sessions, feature tap counts) to improve app stability. No individual user is profiled or tracked.

dataProtection.encryption: All posts and stories are encrypted on your device using AES-256-GCM before transmission. Encryption keys are derived from your device credentials and are never uploaded to our servers.
dataProtection.storage: Encrypted blobs are stored in Firebase Firestore. Firebase never receives or can reconstruct the plaintext of any post.
dataProtection.transit: All data in transit between your device and our servers is protected by TLS 1.3.
dataProtection.keyLoss: If you lose your local encryption key (e.g., by uninstalling the app or clearing data without backup), your content is permanently unrecoverable. We do not hold a key escrow.
dataProtection.serverAccess: No Confess employee, contractor, or third party can read your posts or stories. Server-side access is limited to encrypted metadata (timestamps, UIDs) required for delivery.

notCollected: No real name, phone number, or home address
No photos, videos, audio, or any media uploads
No GPS coordinates or location data of any kind
No access to your contacts, call logs, or SMS messages
No device identifiers such as IMEI, MAC address, or advertising IDs
No browsing history or cross-app behavior

cookiesAndTracking.cookies: The Confess mobile app does not use browser cookies. Our backend may use session tokens stored in secure device storage to maintain your authenticated session.
cookiesAndTracking.thirdPartySDKs: We use Firebase (by Google) for authentication and encrypted storage, and a privacy-respecting crash analytics SDK. Neither is given access to your plaintext content.
cookiesAndTracking.advertisingNetworks: We do not integrate any advertising SDKs. No ad network ever receives your data.
cookiesAndTracking.doNotTrack: We honor system-level 'Limit Ad Tracking' or 'Do Not Track' signals. These signals have no practical additional impact since we do not track users.

dataSharing.summary: We do not sell, rent, lease, or share your personal data with any third party for commercial purposes.
dataSharing.serviceProviders: We use Firebase (Google) as our infrastructure provider. Firebase processes encrypted blobs under strict data processing agreements aligned with Google's data processing terms. Firebase cannot read your content.
dataSharing.legalRequirements: We may disclose metadata (not content — which we cannot access) if required by a valid court order, subpoena, or legal obligation under Indian law. We will notify you of any such request unless prohibited by law.
dataSharing.businessTransfers: In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, user data will only be transferred to a successor that agrees to honor this Privacy Policy. You will be notified 30 days in advance.

dataRetention.posts: Posts remain stored in encrypted form until you manually delete them or delete your account.
dataRetention.stories: Stories automatically expire and are permanently deleted from our servers after 24 hours.
dataRetention.accountDeletion: When you delete your account, all associated metadata (UID, email, reaction records) is purged within 30 days. Encrypted blobs with no associated account are deleted immediately.
dataRetention.analytics: Anonymized crash logs and usage statistics are retained for up to 12 months before being purged.

gdprAndCCPA.applicability: While Confess is governed by Indian law, we extend GDPR-aligned rights to all users globally as a matter of good practice. California residents are also granted rights under CCPA.
gdprRights: Right to Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you (email, UID, reaction metadata).
Right to Rectification: Correct inaccurate personal data.
Right to Erasure ('Right to be Forgotten'): Request deletion of all your personal data.
Right to Restrict Processing: Request that we limit how we use your data.
Right to Data Portability: Receive your encrypted data in a machine-readable format.
Right to Object: Object to processing of your data where we rely on legitimate interest.
Right to Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent at any time without affecting prior lawful processing.
ccpaRights: Right to Know: Know what personal information we collect, use, and disclose.
Right to Delete: Request deletion of personal information we have collected.
Right to Opt-Out: We do not sell personal information. No opt-out mechanism is needed.
Right to Non-Discrimination: Exercising your privacy rights will not result in denial of service.
gdprAndCCPA.howToExercise: Submit requests to support@confessapp.com. We will respond within 30 days. Identity verification may be required.

childrensPrivacy.minimumAge: Confess is not intended for children under the age of 13. Users between 13 and 17 must have verified parental or guardian consent.
childrensPrivacy.unknownMinors: If we become aware that a user under 13 has created an account, we will immediately delete the account and all associated data.
childrensPrivacy.parentalContact: Parents or guardians who believe their child has created an account without consent may contact support@confessapp.com to request deletion.

privacyPolicy.internationalDataTransfers: Your data may be stored on Firebase servers located outside India (including the United States). Such transfers are conducted under Google's standard contractual clauses and data processing agreements, providing safeguards equivalent to Indian data protection standards.
securityMeasures: AES-256-GCM end-to-end encryption for all content
TLS 1.3 for all data in transit
bcrypt hashing for any locally stored passwords
Regular penetration testing and security audits
Principle of least privilege for server-side access controls
No plaintext content ever leaves your device
yourRights: Update your alias at any time within the app
Delete individual posts or all posts at once
Delete your account and all associated metadata
Request deletion of all metadata from our servers
Withdraw consent by deleting your account
privacyPolicy.updates: We will notify you of significant changes to this Privacy Policy via in-app message and email at least 14 days before changes take effect. Continued use of Confess after the effective date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

contact.responseTime: We aim to respond to all privacy-related inquiries within 7 business days.

eligibility.minimumAge: You must be at least 13 years of age to use Confess.
eligibility.minorConsent: Users between the ages of 13 and 17 must have explicit parental or guardian consent before creating an account.
eligibility.representationAndWarranty: By using Confess, you represent and warrant that you meet the eligibility requirements above and that the information you provide during sign-in is accurate.

accountResponsibility.alias: You are responsible for selecting an alias that complies with these Terms. Your alias must not impersonate any real person, brand, or organization.
accountResponsibility.security: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your local device and alias password. Confess is not liable for unauthorized access resulting from your failure to secure your device.
accountResponsibility.oneAccount: Each user may maintain only one active account. Creating duplicate accounts to evade a ban is a violation of these Terms.

terms.identityRules: Your alias is mandatory. You must not impersonate another person, use a name that is offensive, hateful, or sexually explicit, or create an alias designed to mislead other users about your identity.

prohibited: Content that threatens, promotes, or facilitates violence against any individual or group
Content that constitutes hate speech based on race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or national origin
Content that harasses, bullies, or intimidates any individual
Content that promotes, glorifies, or encourages self-harm, eating disorders, or suicide
Content that sexually exploits or depicts minors in any way
Content that reveals personally identifiable information of others (doxxing)
Content that promotes illegal activities, including drug trafficking, fraud, or terrorism
Content that threatens national security or promotes extremist ideologies
Spam, repetitive posts, or automated posting
Media uploads of any kind (Confess is text-only)
contentRules.userResponsibility: Because content is end-to-end encrypted and we cannot read it, you bear full legal and moral responsibility for what you post. Confess provides the platform; you own your words and their consequences.

reactionsOnly.description: Confess does not support comments. The only interaction between users is via reactions.
reactionsOnly.reactionTypes: 👍 Like — acknowledgment; 🤝 Support — empathy and solidarity; 🫂 Us by Us — shared experience.
reactionsOnly.limit: Each user may leave exactly one reaction per post. Reactions cannot be changed once submitted.
reactionsOnly.prohibitedReactionUse: Creating multiple accounts to react multiple times to the same post is a violation of these Terms.

stories.description: Stories are ephemeral, encrypted posts visible for 24 hours after creation.
stories.noInteraction: Stories do not support reactions, comments, or any form of interaction.
stories.expiry: After 24 hours, stories are automatically and permanently deleted from our servers and are unrecoverable.
stories.responsibility: The same content rules that apply to posts apply to stories.

intellectualProperty.yourContent: You retain full ownership of any content you post on Confess. By posting, you grant Confess a limited, non-exclusive, royalty-free license solely to store and transmit your encrypted content for the purpose of providing the service. We never see, use, or commercialize your content.
intellectualProperty.ourIP: The Confess name, logo, interface design, and underlying technology are the intellectual property of the Confess development team and are protected under applicable copyright and trademark law.
intellectualProperty.noUnauthorizedUse: You may not copy, reproduce, distribute, or create derivative works of Confess's interface, branding, or codebase without prior written permission.

moderation.limitations: Due to end-to-end encryption, Confess is technically unable to read or proactively moderate post content.
moderation.localFiltering: Basic keyword filtering may be applied locally on your device during text input to catch obvious violations before encryption.
moderation.metadataReview: If abuse is reported (e.g., a user consistently receiving harassment reports), metadata (UIDs, timestamps, reaction patterns) may be reviewed by our team.
moderation.reporting: Users may flag posts or stories using the in-app report feature. Reports trigger a metadata review; we cannot see the content itself.
moderation.enforcement: Confirmed violations based on metadata patterns, credible reports, or other signals may result in account suspension or permanent ban.

grounds: Creating multiple accounts to evade restrictions
Abusive use of the reaction system
Impersonation of other users or public figures
Any activity that violates applicable law
accountSuspensionAndBan.process: We will attempt to notify banned users via their registered email, except where doing so would compromise an ongoing investigation or is prohibited by law.
accountSuspensionAndBan.appeal: Users may appeal a ban by contacting support@confessapp.com within 14 days of receiving the ban notice. Appeals are reviewed within 10 business days.

privacyPolicy.introduction: Linkium is a privacy-first desktop utility for pairing and remote control of your personal devices. We are committed to collecting the absolute minimum data necessary to provide the service. This Privacy Policy explains exactly what data is collected, where it is stored, how it is protected, and your rights as a user.
infoWeCollect: App Configuration: The names and file system paths of apps you register for remote launching are stored locally on your device in the AppData directory. This data never leaves your machine.

Receiver Code: A unique, randomly generated 10-digit pairing code is stored locally and shared with the remote WebSocket server solely to facilitate device pairing. This code contains no personal identifiers.

Connection Logs: Basic WebSocket session logs (connection time, session duration, pairing code used) are maintained temporarily on the relay server for debugging. No personal identifiers are included.
Settings: User preferences such as startup behavior, tray settings, and display toggles are stored locally in your AppData directory.
Crash Logs: Anonymous error stack traces may be collected to identify and fix software bugs. These contain no personal data.

dataProtection.localStorage: All configuration files, app paths, and preferences are stored in your OS-managed AppData directory, which is protected by your operating system's access controls.
dataProtection.transitEncryption: All WebSocket communications between Linkium and the relay server use TLS (wss://) to prevent interception.
dataProtection.relayServer: The relay server at wss://steamdeck.onrender.com receives only your pairing code and relayed commands. It does not receive app paths, file contents, or any local system data.
dataProtection.noCloud: Linkium does not operate a user database or cloud account system. There is no server-side profile associated with you.
dataProtection.openSource: Linkium's source code is publicly available under the MIT License, allowing independent security audits by the community.

notCollected: No name, email address, or personal profile of any kind
No GPS coordinates or location data
No usage analytics, behavioral tracking, or profiling
No access to your contacts, camera, microphone, or browser history
No file contents — only file paths you explicitly register
No system screenshots or screen recordings

cookiesAndTracking.cookies: Linkium is a desktop application and does not use browser cookies.
cookiesAndTracking.thirdPartySDKs: Linkium does not integrate any third-party analytics, advertising, or tracking SDKs.
cookiesAndTracking.telemetry: The only telemetry collected is anonymous crash reports, which contain no personal identifiers. This can be disabled in settings.
cookiesAndTracking.networkRequests: Linkium makes network requests exclusively to wss://steamdeck.onrender.com for pairing and command relay. No other external endpoints are contacted.

dataSharing.summary: Linkium does not sell, rent, share, or transmit your personal data to any third party.
dataSharing.relayServer: The WebSocket relay server receives your pairing code and the specific commands you initiate (e.g., 'launch app', 'adjust volume'). It does not receive your app paths, file system data, or any other local configuration.
dataSharing.legalRequirements: We may be required to disclose connection logs if compelled by a valid legal order under Indian law. Such logs contain no personal identifiers beyond the pairing code.
dataSharing.openSourceCommunity: As an open-source project, community contributors may review the codebase under the MIT License. No user data is shared with contributors.

dataRetention.localData: All configuration, app paths, and pairing codes remain on your device until you manually delete them or uninstall Linkium.
dataRetention.serverLogs: Connection logs on the relay server are automatically purged after 7 days.
dataRetention.crashLogs: Anonymous crash reports are retained for up to 90 days to assist in debugging, after which they are permanently deleted.
dataRetention.uninstallation: Uninstalling Linkium removes all local data. Residual AppData files can be deleted manually from %AppData%\Linkium.

gdprAndCCPA.applicability: Since Linkium collects minimal personal data and operates no user accounts, GDPR and CCPA obligations are limited. However, we extend the following rights to all users as good practice.
gdprRights: Right to Access: Request a description of any data we hold related to your pairing code or connection logs.
Right to Erasure: Request deletion of any server-side connection logs associated with your pairing code.
Right to Data Portability: Export your local configuration data at any time from within the app.
Right to Object: Disable crash reporting telemetry in the app settings at any time.
ccpaRights: Right to Know: We collect only a pairing code and anonymous crash logs — no personal information.
Right to Delete: Request deletion of server-side connection logs by contacting us with your pairing code.
Right to Non-Discrimination: No service difference for users who exercise privacy rights.
gdprAndCCPA.howToExercise: Contact support@linkium.space. We will respond within 30 days.

childrensPrivacy.minimumAge: Linkium is not directed at children under 13. Users between 13 and 17 should use the software under parental guidance.
childrensPrivacy.noMinorData: We do not knowingly collect any data from children under 13. Since Linkium requires no account creation, there is minimal risk of inadvertent collection.

privacyPolicy.internationalDataTransfers: The relay server may be hosted on infrastructure outside India (currently Render.com). Only your anonymous pairing code and relay commands pass through this server, protected by TLS. No personal data is stored server-side.
securityMeasures: TLS (wss://) encryption for all WebSocket communications
Local data stored in OS-protected AppData directory
No server-side user database or profile storage
Pairing codes are randomly generated and can be regenerated at any time
Open-source codebase enabling community security review
No third-party analytics or tracking SDKs
yourRights: View and manage all locally stored configuration data within the app
Delete your local configuration and registered app list at any time
Regenerate your receiver code at any time for enhanced security
Disable background startup and tray operation in settings
Disable crash reporting telemetry in settings
Request deletion of server-side connection logs via email
privacyPolicy.updates: Significant changes to our privacy practices will be communicated through GitHub release notes and the official website at linkium.space. We encourage users to review release notes before updating.

contact.responseTime: We aim to respond to all privacy-related inquiries within 7 business days.
